processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Sound portion of the 30 kg vacuum-induction-melted ingot homogenized at 1423 K for 2.5 h prior to hot rolling.
Hot rolled at 1323 K to a final plate thickness of ~13 mm; this condition is denoted HR. Details reported elsewhere [21].

processing_steps.reduction_ratio: ~50% reduction in thickness (~6 mm thick sheets)
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Hot-rolled plates cold rolled at room temperature in several passes to ~50% reduction (~6 mm); cold-rolled condition denoted HR+CR.
Cold-rolled sheet heat treated at 1023 K for 1 h followed by water quenching; the heat-treated samples are designated by their heat-treatment temperature.

structures.overall_structure: Partially recrystallized austenitic (γ, FCC) low-density steel containing predominantly banded/elongated deformed austenite grains coexisting with fine recrystallized austenite grains (~10% recrystallized), thin RD-aligned B2 stringers and concurrent secondary precipitates (fine intragranular B2, coarser intergranular B2 and κ-carbides).

average_grain_size.value: a few μm (stays at or below the few-μm level)

precipitates.distribution: fine intragranular κ-carbides within recrystallized grains

phases_present.morphology: strongly banded, elongated/columnar grains aligned along RD

defects.type: retained stored strain / intermediate-to-high local misorientation (KAM green–yellow fields with blue low-misorientation patches)

precipitates.distribution: inhomogeneous and relatively coarse κ-carbides in deformed austenite regions

phases_present.morphology: thin, elongated stringers oriented roughly parallel to RD

defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: Nucleation of recrystallized grains occurs mostly along the γ/γ boundaries and γ/B2 interface; intragranular B2 particles do not pin newly recrystallized grains but may delay overall recovery (general observation for the alloy system, includes 28Mn5Ni).

interfaces.slip_behavior: Not reported specifically for the 1023 K condition of this sample; for the alloy system, concurrent B2/κ-carbide precipitation delays recrystallization and promotes inhomogeneous slip band spacing in Ni-containing LDS.
interfaces.phase_evolution: Upon heat treatment, intragranular and intergranular B2 and κ-carbides precipitate concurrently with austenite recrystallization; the B2 fraction decreases with increasing heat-treatment temperature.
interfaces.interface_notes: No microcrack/γ-B2 crack-propagation data specific to 28Mn5Ni at 1023 K; intergranular cracking along γ/B2 was reported for the 15Mn5Ni alloy, not this sample.

measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: flat tensile specimen, gauge length 30 mm, width 6 mm, thickness 4–5 mm
measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Tests triplicated; average of three readings reported.

yield_strength.note: YS at 0.2% offset, HR+CR+1023 K condition

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: At HR+CR+1023 K, Ni addition (28Mn5Ni) retains higher strength (YS 1289 MPa, UTS 1537 MPa, TE 17%) than the Ni-free 28Mn0Ni (YS 732 MPa, UTS 1051 MPa, TE 36%): Ni addition delayed austenite recrystallization (~10% recrystallized in 28Mn5Ni) and gave dual precipitates of intragranular/intergranular B2 and κ-carbides, maintaining a better strength level.

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Zeiss Supra 55 FEG-SEM with Nordley EBSD detector (Oxford); step size 120 nm (fine) / 250 nm (coarse); samples polished to colloidal silica ~100 nm finish; data analysed with TSL-OIM software
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Map areas ~100×100 µm² (fine) and ~200×200 µm² (coarse); three scans per sample; KAM and GOS 2° criterion used to delineate recrystallized microstructure
characterization_methods.purpose: Quantify grain orientations, recrystallized fraction, grain size, twin fraction and B2 phase fraction; obtain IPF, phase-contrast and KAM maps
characterization_methods.key_findings: For 28Mn5Ni in HR+CR+1023 K: strongly banded/elongated austenite grains with a dashed-box inset revealing fine recrystallized austenite grains (20 µm scale, 2 µm inset); phase map shows red FCC matrix with a small number of thin, mostly RD-aligned blue B2 stringers; KAM map shows mixed green and yellow fields with blue low-misorientation patches (intermediate-to-high local misorientation).

characterization_methods.technique: Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) bright-field/dark-field with SAED and TEM-EDS
characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: FEI TECNAI 20T G2 operating at 200 kV equipped with EDAX EDS; twin-jet electropolished specimens (mixed acid electrolyte at 243 K)
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Dark-field images captured from (010) κ-carbide satellite spots
characterization_methods.purpose: Identify and characterize phases (κ-carbides, intragranular/intergranular B2) not resolvable at SEM-EBSD scale
characterization_methods.key_findings: TEM studies were carried out on selected heat-treated samples; the 973 K condition of 28Mn5Ni contained mixed recrystallized/deformed austenite with fine intragranular B2, intergranular B2 and κ-carbides. Note: TEM was reported only at 973 K and 1173 K, not specifically the 1023 K condition of this sample.

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: AFFRI Vickers hardness tester; peak load 30 kg (~300 N); dwell time 15 s; ASTM E-140-02
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Averaged over ten measurements per sample
characterization_methods.purpose: Evaluate change in hardness with cold work and heat treatment
characterization_methods.key_findings: Hardness of all alloys saturated to ~450 VHN at 50% cold reduction; Ni-containing alloys softened monotonically with heat-treatment temperature (Fig. 8b data points at 873, 973, 1073, 1173, 1273 K — no 1023 K point reported).

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Room temperature; constant cross-head speed 0.5 mm min^-1 (initial strain rate ~3×10^-4 s^-1); ASTM E8M; triplicated
characterization_methods.purpose: Evaluate strength and ductility in different processing conditions
characterization_methods.key_findings: 28Mn5Ni in HR+CR+1023 K: YS 1289±2 MPa, UTS 1537±2 MPa, TE 17±1%.

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Fracture surfaces of tensile specimens tested at room temperature
characterization_methods.purpose: Examine fracture mode of failed tensile specimens
characterization_methods.key_findings: Fractography of all three alloys heat treated at 1023 K: 28Mn5Ni exhibited dimple morphology indicating ductile failure (contrasted with quasi-cleavage in 15Mn5Ni).

unmapped_findings: The strain-hardening exponent n for 28Mn5Ni at HR+CR+1023 K is not reported (n column blank in Table 3); for the 1173 K condition both Ni-containing alloys exhibited a nearly identical lower n value of ~0.30.

TEM-EDS composition of B2 particles in 28Mn5Ni (reported only for 973 K and 1173 K, not for this sample's 1023 K condition): 973 K → Mn 16.3 / Al 12.7 / Ni 24.6 wt.% (Mn 14.7 / Al 23.3 / Ni 20.8 at.%); 1173 K Particle-1 → Mn 16.5 / Al 14.2 / Ni 26.1 wt.% (Mn 14.9 / Al 25.7 / Ni 21.8 at.%); 1173 K Particle-2 → Mn 15.4 / Al 14.8 / Ni 27.5 wt.% (Mn 13.7 / Al 26.7 / Ni 22.8 at.%); balance Fe.
Prior B2 stringer volume fraction in 28Mn5Ni is ~4% in the hot-rolled (HR) condition (vs ~12% for 15Mn5Ni).
In the 1023 K sample of 28Mn5Ni, fine secondary B2 was precipitated mostly along grain boundaries (contrasted with a coarser precipitate-rich zone around deformed austenite in 15Mn5Ni).

Vickers hardness data for 28Mn5Ni vs heat-treatment temperature is plotted only for 873, 973, 1073, 1173 and 1273 K (Fig. 8b) — no value at 1023 K is reported; Ni-containing alloys showed a peak near 500 VHN at 873 K that dropped monotonically with temperature.

General (alloy-system, not sample-specific) TEM at 973 K showed fine intragranular B2 (5–20 nm), intergranular B2 (50–200 nm), and coarse κ-carbides of 10–60 nm in deformed austenite regions (sizes reported for the 973 K condition, retained here for reference only).
